title: SSH and SFTP
intro: Log in as the user {{user}} with a key, never with a password. A key is for SFTP only unless you allow a shell; a shell can run any command as the site user. Logins see the server as the site's PHP code does.
disabled: The site is disabled: nobody can log in until it is enabled. The keys are kept.
none: No keys yet: nobody can log in.
max: A site has at most {{max}} keys.

login.label: Login of {{site}}
login.fingerprints: At the first login, check that the server shows one of these fingerprints:
login.failed: The server's host key fingerprints could not be read right now.

key.label: Label
key.deleteText: Delete this key? Sessions that are open now keep running.

access.sftpText: {{name}}: upload and download files, no commands
access.shellText: {{name}}: also a terminal, for wp-cli, composer or git

new.label: New SSH key
new.publicHint: The contents of a .pub file, for example ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub. Ed25519, ECDSA or RSA with at least 3072 bits.
new.keyLabelHint: Shown in the list, so you know whose key it is.

check.labelEmpty: Enter a label, for example the name of the computer.
check.labelLong: The label is longer than {{max}} characters.
check.labelSpace: The label must not start or end with a space.
check.labelChars: The label may contain letters, digits, spaces and . _ - @ + only.
check.keyEmpty: Paste a public key, the contents of a file like id_ed25519.pub.
check.keyPrivate: This is a private key. Never paste it anywhere; paste the .pub file instead.
check.keyLines: Paste one key on one line.
check.keyType: This does not look like a supported public key. Use an Ed25519, ECDSA or RSA (3072 bits or more) key.

errors.ssh_unavailable: SSH access is not available on this panel.
errors.too_many_ssh_keys: A site has at most {{max}} keys. Delete one first.
errors.ssh_key_exists: The site already has this key.
errors.site_busy: The site is not active right now. Reload the page in a moment.
errors.forbidden: Only administrators can manage SSH keys.
errors.keyGone: This key does not exist any more. Reload the page.
